fact: In November 2024 two WHO Regional Office consultants, with the WHO country office and the Ministry of Health's M&E team, set up DHIS2 for Eswatini within the Ministry's Strategic Health Information Department; its domain was hosted on UNICEF servers, and the M&E unit said further WHO technical support and IT equipment were needed for it to be fully functional.
title: Newsletter, December 2024, issue 4
